Subject: Sponsor wedge & EB finalization — next steps to lock close

Team / Liam,

Thanks again for a productive demo yesterday. Acme is one of the cleanest fits we've had in Q4, and procurement signaled they want an EB (executive briefing) week-of-Dec 6 to finalize the roadmap and procurement milestones. Before we lock dates I want to align on:

- Executive sponsor roster (we need confirmed names + backup execs)
- MAP commitments and who owns each action item on Acme's side vs ours
- Evaluation plan: primary criteria, test datasets, and a concrete evaluation window
- Contract gating items that could move close past the EB

I've attached a working MAP (RDW-Acme-MAP-v3.xlsx) and a draft EB agenda. Please:
1) Marissa — can you review/trim the sponsor roster in the attached PDF and mark who will be our exec that introduces Redwood?
2) Ben — procurement/contract checklist: which items need legal signoff before EB?
3) Grace/Logan — propose two EB windows (30–45 minute exec slot + 60 min technical slot) that accommodate US pacific and CET execs.

Liam/Claire — are you still targeting week-of-Dec 6 for EB? If yes, include preferred dates/times and confirm the internal exec(s) who must attend.

Goal: lock EB date by EOD Monday so we can ship the MAP with owner assignments and the evaluation plan to Acme.

Thanks —
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova

Sofia — thanks, this looks good. Week-of-Dec 6 still works for us. Quick answers:

- Execs: Our CIO (Marcus Flynn) will attend; Claire is coordinating the product exec (Sara Patel) as backup. I will confirm Marcus by Monday.
- Evaluation: we want an offline run on our 10k-document test set with a short rubric (precision on entity extraction + latency SLA). Can Redwood seed the environment for an A/B run?
- Procurement: procurement flagged two items that need to be in place before signature: (1) data processing addendum, (2) 90-day SLA uplift clause for dedicated capacity.

Proposed EB windows (our timezone PST): Dec 7 10:00–12:00 or Dec 8 13:00–15:00. Let me know which you prefer.

Thanks —
Liam
